description: This file defines the JunitSuiteWrapper class which is used to assemble and manage JUnit test suites based on XML configurations in the Apache OFBiz framework. It loads test suite data, constructs internal representations, and provides methods to retrieve and populate test suites with test cases.

classes.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
classes.description: A utility class to initialize, manage, and retrieve collections of JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that loads test suite information for a given component and suite name, parsing XML resources to build internal test suite representations.

methods.name: populateTestSuite
methods.description: Deprecated method to add all configured tests from the internal model test suites to a given JUnit TestSuite object.

methods.name: getModelTestSuites
methods.description: Returns the list of loaded ModelTestSuite objects.

methods.name: getAllTestList
methods.description: Returns a flattened list of all Test instances from all loaded ModelTestSuites.
